description_en: Queries the numbers of inbound and outbound packets of a dedicated instance within a period of time
description_zh: 查看专享实例一定时间内流入流出数据包数
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi describe-instance-packets --start-time 2022-05-18T01:14:26Z --end-time 2022-05-24T10:14:53Z --instance-id apigateway-cn-2r426lavr001 --sbc-name Maximum --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstancePackets

parameters.help_en: The start time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The statistical metric. Valid values:

Maximum

Minimum

Average
parameters.help_zh:
统计指标
Maximum 最大
Minimum 最小
Average 平均
parameters.name: sbc_name

MonitorItem.description_en: The list of inbound and outbound data packets in the instance
MonitorItem.description_zh: 实例流入/流出的数据包

Item.description_en:
The metric. Valid values:

InstancePacketRX: inbound data packets

InstancePacketTX: outbound data packets
Item.description_zh:
指标
InstancePacketRX 流入数据包
InstancePacketTX 流出数据包

ItemTime.description_en: The monitoring time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
ItemTime.description_zh: 对应时间，按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

ItemValue.description_en: The number of inbound and outbound data packets in the instance
